WITH busc AS
(
SELECT
BDG.FORACID AS CustomerAccountId,
BDT.TRAN_DATE_BAL
FROM  BUSC.LNS_EODACCTBAL BDT 
LEFT JOIN  BUSC.LNS_GENERALACCTMAST BDG ON BDG.ACID = BDT.ACID AND BDG.ISLATEST = '1'
WHERE BDG.FORACID IS NOT NULL AND BDT.ISLATEST = '1' AND CONVERT(CHAR(8),EOD_DATE,112)  <= 20230110 AND CONVERT(CHAR(8),END_EOD_DATE,112)  >= 20230110

)
,exclude_FORACID AS (
SELECT FORACID FROM 
    (SELECT FORACID, COUNT(*) AS CNT 
    FROM (SELECT FORACID, ACID FROM busc.LNS_GENERALACCTMAST WHERE DEL_FLG != 'Y' GROUP BY FORACID, ACID) A
    GROUP BY FORACID HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) B
)
SELECT 
    SUM(TRAN_DATE_BAL)
    FROM busc 
    WHERE CustomerAccountId NOT IN (SELECT * FROM exclude_FORACID)
